description: pkix-revocation/src/lib.rs:72-77 — The OcspResponderIdMismatch variant has a doc comment (lines 72-77), so this finding is partially addressed. However the doc comment says 'byName DN or byKey SHA-1 hash' but does not mention that the SHA-1 used here is specifically SHA-1 of the SPKI subjectPublicKey raw bytes (not of the full SubjectPublicKeyInfo DER), which is the non-obvious part. Compare ocsp.rs:477 where spki_raw = subject_public_key.raw_bytes(). A reader of lib.rs alone cannot reconstruct the correct hash input. Suggest adding: 'byKey: SHA-1 of the issuer SPKI subjectPublicKey bit string (raw bytes, tag/length/unused-bits stripped)' to the variant doc.
title: OcspResponderIdMismatch variant missing doc comment
